name: gh-stack
tagline: Official GitHub CLI extension for stacked pull requests
description: gh-stack is GitHub's official CLI extension for managing stacked pull requests. It restructures stacked-branch workflows with a TUI so developers can visualize and orchestrate a chain of dependent PRs from a single interface. By making stacked PRs first-class in the GitHub CLI, it removes the manual bookkeeping that usually makes stacked development error-prone. It is built in Go and designed to sit naturally alongside the existing gh CLI.
highlights: Official GitHub CLI extension for stacked pull requests
TUI for visualizing and orchestrating chains of dependent PRs
Removes manual bookkeeping from stacked development
Sits naturally alongside the existing gh CLI
curatorNote: Stacked PRs are powerful but notoriously fiddly to manage by hand. GitHub shipping an official CLI extension with a TUI signals that stacked workflows are becoming a first-class development practice.
